title.narrative: Enhancing Lesotho#s private sector readiness for a clean energy transition

description.narrative: Lesotho accords high priority to clean energy transition as a key strategy to meet its NDC commitments. Private sector engagement is key to achieving GCF#s mandate and objectives, and Lesotho#s NDC emphasizes the need to strengthen national expertise and capacities for technology development and adoption. This signals that private sector#s capacity to provide technology solutions on a commercial basis will be a catalytic factor in achieving Lesotho#s climate and clean energy goals. Therefore, this proposal aims to enhance the readiness of Lesotho#s private sector to develop, commercialize and scale-up innovative climate and clean energy technology (cleantech) solutions, and also maximize the economic growth opportunities embedded therein, through # strengthened capacity of local SMEs to develop and commercialize innovative cleantech solutions as profitable business models to meet the market demand # enhanced awareness of the local financial sector of the cleantech market opportunities Through strengthened awareness and capacity of the private sector to engage and guide the GCF processes, Lesotho#s GCF programming is expected to better leverage private sector potential in meeting the country#s climate and energy goals, while at the same time achieveing sustainable economic growth.
